install.title: App
install.hint: Install Stickly on your home screen: it opens like an app, full screen.
install.installed: Stickly is installed: open it from its icon on your home screen.
install.iosStep1: Tap Share: in Safari, the square with the arrow pointing up (at the bottom or next to the address); in Chrome, the same icon in the address bar.
install.iosStep3: Open Stickly from the new icon.
install.androidStep2: Choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
